lines.o1: A model tries to fit a curve through the training points.
lines.o2: Too simple, and it underfits. Too flexible, and it overfits, chasing every wiggle of noise.
lines.o3: The real test is new data that the model has not seen.
lines.o4: The overfit curve is perfect on the training set, but fails on the test data.
lines.o5: As complexity grows, training error keeps falling, but test error turns upward.
lines.o6: Fixes include more data, simpler models, regularisation, and early stopping.
lines.outro: Learn the pattern, not the noise.
